title: Hidden Patterns

beats.narrativeText: With enough expedition data recovered, Atlas asks the learner to examine measurements collected over many months.
Individually, the records seem ordinary, but something about them feels connected.
The learner compares datasets from across the expedition's records.
Creating graphs of the combined data begins to reveal a pattern that had gone unnoticed.
The learner must identify the trend and explain their conclusions using evidence.
The hidden pattern connects evidence from several earlier missions at once.
The learner reflects on how investigations that once seemed unrelated are actually connected.
The learner's confidence in interpreting complex information grows, sensing that a much bigger picture is starting to form.

activities.title: Compare Datasets
activities.storyContext: Atlas asks the learner to examine measurements collected over many months.
activities.instructions: Compare a few datasets collected at different points during the expedition.

activities.title: Create Graphs
activities.storyContext: Individually, the records seem ordinary, but combined they might reveal something more.
activities.instructions: Create graphs combining the datasets to make any patterns easier to see.

activities.title: Identify Trends
activities.storyContext: A repeating pattern has gone unnoticed until now.
activities.instructions: Identify any trend that appears across the combined graphs.
activities.output: A description of the identified trend.

activities.title: Explain Conclusions Using Evidence
activities.storyContext: A good conclusion is always supported by evidence.
activities.instructions: Explain what the trend means, using evidence from the datasets to support your conclusion.
activities.output: A written conclusion supported by evidence.

activities.title: Predict Future Observations
activities.storyContext: If the trend continues, future observations should follow the same pattern.
activities.instructions: Use the identified trend to predict what future observations might show.
activities.output: A prediction supported by the identified trend.

activities.title: Discovering Hidden Patterns in Data
activities.storyContext: Finding hidden patterns in large amounts of data is a real scientific skill.
activities.instructions: Find out how scientists discover hidden patterns within large datasets.
activities.output: None required — this is an open investigation.

prompts: Which earlier missions do you think are connected by this pattern, and why?

discussionPoints: What pattern did you notice once the datasets were combined?
Which earlier missions do you think are connected, and why?
parentGuide.assessment: Look for a clearly explained trend supported by evidence drawn from multiple datasets.

completionCriteria: Datasets compared, graphs created, and trends explained using evidence.
